# orch8_trigger (Resource)

An Orch8 trigger that starts instances of a sequence (`POST /triggers`). Changing the target sequence with a pinned `version` retargets in place (`PATCH /triggers/{slug}/target`); every other change replaces the trigger.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orch8_trigger" "signup" {
  slug          = "user-signup"
  sequence_name = orch8_sequence.welcome.name
  version       = orch8_sequence.welcome.version # pinned: bumping retargets in place
  secret        = var.signup_webhook_secret
}

variable "signup_webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sequence_name` (String) Name of the sequence to start.
- `slug` (String) Unique trigger slug (used in `/webhooks/{slug}` and `/triggers/{slug}/fire`).

### Optional

- `config` (String) Type-specific configuration as a JSON object (e.g. NATS subject, file path, activepieces_poll settings).
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the target sequence. Defaults to `default`.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Shared secret callers must present (`x-trigger-secret` / HMAC). Write-only: the engine never returns it, so out-of-band changes are not detected. Changing it replaces the trigger.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant. Defaults to the provider's tenant_id.
- `trigger_type` (String) One of `webhook`, `nats`, `file_watch`, `event`, `activepieces_poll`. Defaults to `webhook`.
- `version` (Number) Pin a sequence version. Omit to always use the latest version.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the trigger is enabled.
- `id` (String) Same as `slug`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (used for optimistic concurrency on retarget).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by slug. `secret` is write-only and must be set in configuration.
terraform import orch8_trigger.signup user-signup
```
